sources.title: RECURSIVE MANUFACTURING FACILITY FOR HUMANOID ROBOTS [US20260277194A1]
sources.abstract: [0000]    A manufacturing system in which robots produced by the system are authorized to join a recursive workforce that performs manufacturing operations on subsequently produced robots. A genealogy store maintains, for each robot, a record identifying constituent components and the agents—including specific robots of the recursive workforce—that performed each manufacturing operation, encoding a multi-generational graph linking manufactured robots to the robots that manufactured them. Newly manufactured robots autonomously perform completion operations on themselves, including self-calibration using onboard perception without external measurement equipment, application of physical coverings to their own bodies, stress-testing through self-directed physical movement, and self-positioning within shipping containers. A production management system interfaces with vision-language-action models executing on the robots to transmit task specifications, receive manufacturing outcome data, and maintain traceability records, enabling the robots to perform assembly, quality inspection, and adaptive manipulation within the production facility.

sources.title: ROBOTIC-VIEW 3D VISION LANGUAGE ACTION MODELING VIA MULTI-VIEW HEATMAP GENERATION [US20260268120A1]
sources.abstract: [0000]    Apparatuses, systems, and techniques are disclosed for controlling a robot to execute a task. In at least one embodiment, one or more view images, each corresponding to a predefined view of a set of predefined views, are obtained based on a plurality of input images representing observations of a scene. Based on the encoded input, a large language model (LLM) is utilized to predict a plurality of action tokens corresponding to a future state of the robot. The plurality of action tokens are decoded to generate one or more output images, each corresponding to a predefined view. The one or more output images indicate probability distributions of a location of the robot or an end-effector of the robot in a future state of the robot. A three-dimensional (3D) position corresponding to the future state of the robot is determined based on the probability distributions.

sources.title: Non-contact tomato picking control method based on vision-language-action model and control system thereof [CN122645293A]
sources.abstract: The invention provides a non-contact tomato picking control method based on a vision-language-action model and a control system thereof, and the method comprises the following steps: collecting an RGB-D image and a natural language instruction, and respectively extracting vision and semantic features through ViT-Marge and T5-Marge; detecting key points of fruits and calyxes by using Center Net, and recovering three-dimensional picking points and directions in combination with a depth map; with the language features as queries and the visual features as key values, fusing ontology perception information through cross attention, and constructing state vectors; outputting an action instruction by adopting a multi-layer perceptron strategy network; and designing a reward function containing high-weight collision penalty, and combining behavior cloning and PPO two-stage training. According to the method, understanding of a natural language instruction is accurately close to collision-free, the collision rate of branches and leaves is remarkably reduced, and the picking success rate and the sim < 2 > real migration efficiency are improved.

sources.title: Self-adaptive step length control method for live broadcast interaction robot [CN122661480A]
authors: CHONGQING CHETU SHIJIE NETWORK TECH CO LTD
sources.organization: CHONGQING CHETU SHIJIE NETWORK TECH CO LTD
sources.abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of intelligent robot control, and particularly relates to a self-adaptive step length control method for a live broadcast interaction robot. Comprising the following steps: identifying a robot control instruction from bullet screen text information, and inputting the robot control instruction and a live scene image into a vision-language-action model for processing to obtain a candidate action sequence under current iteration; sequentially calculating window action deviation and convergence slope of each action site in the candidate action sequence; if the window action deviation and convergence slope of the first m action sites meet the stable condition, and the (m + 1) th action site does not meet the stable condition, outputting the first m action sites; otherwise, outputting the candidate action sequence again; the live broadcast interaction robot executes the first m action sites and continues to process the remaining action sites in the candidate action sequence at the same time until the whole robot control instruction is executed; according to the method, high-frequency low-delay interaction can be realized while the control stability is ensured, and the method is more suitable for a cost-sensitive and high-concurrency live broadcast environment.

sources.title: Multi-modal large model integrated deployment and heterogeneous unmanned system control method and device [CN122655979A]
authors: BEIJING DUANDIAN ZHIZAO TECH CO LTD
sources.organization: BEIJING DUANDIAN ZHIZAO TECH CO LTD
sources.abstract: The invention discloses a multi-mode large model integrated deployment and heterogeneous unmanned system control method and device. The method comprises the following steps: receiving a natural language instruction, decomposing the natural language instruction into an ordered standardized subtask sequence through a task semantic analysis engine, inputting the ordered standardized subtask sequence and observation data acquired and converted by a hardware abstraction layer into a vision-language-action large model inference engine together for fusion inference, generating a bottom-layer action instruction sequence, and generating a bottom-layer action instruction sequence; and converting the action instruction sequence into an underlying control protocol message which can be identified by the target heterogeneous unmanned system, issuing and executing the underlying control protocol message, generating platform standard feedback data through a hardware abstraction layer according to a sensor feedback message generated by execution, and returning the platform standard feedback data to a front end through a dispatching center. According to the technical scheme, the heterogeneous unmanned system can be directly driven by the natural language instruction to execute the task, the cross-device development adaptation cost is reduced, the end-side reasoning and control response efficiency is improved, and standardized feedback and visual monitoring of the execution state are achieved.

sources.title: Vision-language-action model training method and device, model and application system [CN122637135A]
authors: BEIJING XINGDONG JIYUAN TECH CO LTD
sources.organization: BEIJING XINGDONG JIYUAN TECH CO LTD
sources.abstract: The invention discloses a vision-language-action model training method and device, a model and an application system, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining a real machine interaction data set facing a target business scene through a preset progressive closed-loop data collection process; wherein the progressive closed-loop data acquisition process comprises a basic acquisition stage, a directional acquisition stage, an error correction acquisition stage and an online acquisition stage; based on the real machine interaction data set, in combination with differentiated instructions designed for scene features, operation logic and task types, the vision-language-action model is trained, so that the vision-language-action model obtained through training has the cross-scene and cross-task generalization migration ability; and obtaining a vision-language-action model suitable for the target business scene.

sources.title: Dynamic memory enhancement method and system oriented to vision-language-action model, and readable storage medium [CN122634497A]
sources.abstract: The invention provides a dynamic memory enhancement method and system oriented to a vision-language-action model, and a storage medium, and solves the problems of memory short vision, memory pollution and incapability of dynamically adjusting a fusion weight in a long-sight-distance task of an existing VLA model. The method comprises the following steps: constructing a working memory and retrieving a historical memory from a perception-cognition-reward memory library; performing adaptive weighted fusion on the current memory and the historical memory by using a gating network with trainable parameters to generate enhanced working memory; calculating a task progress difference value based on the enhanced working memory by adopting a progress evaluator, and generating a single-step intensive reward; performing online strategy optimization on gating network parameters by taking the reward as a dominant function; when the memory bank is full, reward weighted combination is carried out on adjacent entries based on weighted indexes of feature similarity and reward similarity; and finally, the action expert network outputs an action sequence. The method can be used for robot long-time-sequence task learning and adaptive control in a dynamic environment.

sources.title: Unmanned aerial vehicle autonomous obstacle avoidance navigation method and system based on visual language action model and world model [CN122632852A]
sources.abstract: The invention provides an unmanned aerial vehicle autonomous obstacle avoidance navigation method and system based on a visual language action model and a world model, and the method comprises the steps: S1, obtaining a high-level semantic action guided by a cross-view target through employing a Transform-based double-end joint training VLA model; s2, carrying out the compression of a submerged space state through a world model, predicting the semantic expression of an obstacle through a JEPA style predictor, building a reward function of the world model by taking the semantic meaning of the obstacle as a main part, and generating an action based on the semantic meaning of the environment. S3, adaptively adjusting target guidance and action weights of environmental semantics according to actual environmental information, and optimizing a current track by taking the current and past states of the unmanned aerial vehicle as reinforcement learning reward functions, so as to generate a more intelligent and reasonable navigation strategy.

sources.title: VLA learning method and system based on shape alignment humanoid robot [CN122626219A]
authors: DEEP INTELLIGENT BEIJING TECH CO LTD
sources.organization: DEEP INTELLIGENT BEIJING TECH CO LTD
sources.abstract: The invention discloses a VLA learning method and system based on a form-aligned humanoid robot, and the method comprises the steps: S1, obtaining a human demonstration synchronous multi-view video, and generating a high-degree-of-freedom robot motion tag through a third-view video; s2, using visual language features extracted by the first view angle video, a current robot state and a noisy action segment as model input, using a high-degree-of-freedom action segment as model output, using a high-degree-of-freedom robot action label as action supervision, constructing a training sample to train a VLA model, and adding double-space layered kinematics constraint in training; and S3, decoding the high-degree-of-freedom relative action fragment predicted by the model into an absolute joint state, and directly sending the absolute joint state to a robot controller for execution. High-degree-of-freedom humanoid robot executable actions can be generated from synchronous camera videos in near real time, and the geometric consistency of joint space output and task space is kept in the learning stage.

sources.title: Robot operation method, system and equipment based on visual token adaptive caching [CN122626298A]
authors: QINGDAO HAIER INTELLIGENT TECHNOLOGY RES & DEV CO LTD
sources.organization: QINGDAO HAIER INTELLIGENT TECHNOLOGY RES & DEV CO LTD
sources.abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robot control, and provides a robot operation method, system and equipment based on visual token adaptive caching, and the method comprises the steps: recognizing static candidate tokens according to the feature similarity between a visual token at the current moment and a visual token corresponding to the previous moment; according to the target mask and the text-visual attention score, removing the key token from the static candidate tokens to obtain a reusable token set; according to the attention entropy of each network layer, hierarchically determining a multiplexing proportion, selecting a token to be multiplexed from the reusable token set according to the multiplexing proportion to multiplex the key value cache at the previous moment, and recalculating the key value cache for other visual tokens to obtain a new key value cache; and outputting the robot action based on the new key value cache. The VLA model reasoning delay can be reduced, the real-time control frequency of the robot is improved, meanwhile, the operation precision is kept, and the method is suitable for robot autonomous grabbing, placing, industrial feeding and other scenes.

sources.title: Automatic inspection robot traffic inspection method based on urban traffic scene [CN122637589A]
sources.abstract: The invention provides an automatic inspection robot traffic inspection method based on an urban traffic scene, and relates to the technical field of intelligent traffic, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining original multi-modal sensor data from an inspection robot hardware platform, carrying out the preprocessing, constructing a BEV space representation learning module for standard multi-modal sensor data, and carrying out the recognition of the BEV space representation learning module; meanwhile, a VLA model module is constructed, a traffic event detection and anomaly recognition module is constructed, an end-to-end motion planning and navigation module and a man-machine interaction and remote management module are constructed, and a model training and deployment strategy is defined to carry out model training and deployment on the multiple modules to control the automatic inspection robot to carry out traffic inspection. The technical problem that an inspection robot is difficult to realize efficient and reliable autonomous inspection in a complex traffic environment due to insufficient perception, semantic understanding and navigation planning capabilities in the prior art is solved. The technical effects of autonomous perception, intelligent decision making and efficient inspection of the inspection robot in a complex traffic environment are achieved.

sources.title: Vision-language-action model-oriented look-ahead and review collaborative decision-making method and system [CN122615122A]
sources.abstract: The invention discloses a look-ahead and review collaborative decision-making method and system for a vision-language-action model, and the method comprises the steps: constructing a vision-language-action basic model, introducing a scene memory module, coding a current observation and instruction into a working memory, and retrieving historical context features from an external memory library through a cross attention mechanism; a generative world model is introduced, prospective lexical elements are added in model input, and future observation features are predicted with historical context features obtained through work memory and retrieval as conditions; a prediction deviation driven gating mechanism is introduced, deviation signals of prediction observation and real observation are evaluated, an adaptive gating value is calculated to dynamically fuse current observation and historical memory features, and fused context features, predicted future states and action query lexical elements are jointly input into an action decoder to generate control actions. According to the method, the problems of time sequence short view and error accumulation caused by the fact that an existing VLA model excessively depends on current single observation are effectively solved.

sources.title: Body robot action generation method, system and equipment based on structured action characterization and medium [CN122606657A]
sources.abstract: The invention relates to a structured action representation-based motion generation method, system and equipment for a robot with a body, and a storage medium. The method comprises the following steps: inputting current observation information obtained by observing a current scene into a vision-language-action model based on an OneModel architecture, and extracting to obtain a potential strategy feature containing scene perception information and a task execution intention; determining a local coordinate system based on the potential strategy features; on the basis of the potential strategy features and a shared prototype action library, generating a local execution action corresponding to the current moment in a local coordinate system; converting the local execution action into an initial execution action in a world coordinate system; and based on the initial execution action and the supplementary control parameters, the final execution action of the robot with the body at the current moment is determined. Therefore, the cooperation between the task execution intention and the structured action representation can be realized by utilizing the OneModel architecture, and the action generation stability and generalization ability of the robot with the body are improved.

sources.title: Multi-task reasoning method and device based on visual language action model [CN122616720A]
sources.abstract: The invention provides a multi-task reasoning method and device based on a visual language action model. The method comprises the steps of obtaining first environment observation data corresponding to a current control period; wherein a first visual image and a first task instruction are included; inputting the first environment observation data into a visual language action (VLA) model, performing coding processing on a first visual image and a first task instruction in the first environment observation data in the VLA model, determining a first key value (KV) vector corresponding to the first environment observation data, and caching the first KV vector in a first cache region; in the VLA model, through an action expert reasoning module, according to the first KV vector cached in the first cache region, generating an action of the current control period; and synchronously generating a language of the current control period through a language expert reasoning module in the VLA model according to the first KV vector cached in the first cache region. By adopting the technical scheme of the invention, computing resources can be saved.

sources.title: Combined action learning system oriented to visual language action model [CN122616604A]
sources.abstract: The invention provides a visual language action model-oriented combined action learning system. The system comprises an offline data processing module and an online training module, the offline data processing module comprises a large language model instruction decomposition unit and an ontology sensing track alignment unit; the online training module comprises a mixed training unit and a state condition asymmetric shielding unit. The visual language action model-oriented combined action learning system can overcome the problems of track overfitting, shortcut perception and weak extraterritorial task generalization ability of the existing VLA model, and can give consideration to the intra-distribution task execution stability and the extraterritorial task combination generalization ability.

sources.title: Bolt tightening method based on vision-language-action model [CN122584293A]
authors: SHENYANG INTELLIGENT ROBOT INNOVATION CENTER CO LTD
sources.organization: SHENYANG INST AUTOMATION CAS, SHENYANG INTELLIGENT ROBOT INNOVATION CENTER CO LTD
sources.abstract: The invention discloses a bolt tightening method based on a vision-language-action model, and belongs to the technical field of intelligent manufacturing. The method comprises the following steps: collecting scene image data of a target bolt and a peripheral workpiece area of the target bolt, and extracting multi-scale visual features from the collected scene image data to obtain a multi-scale visual feature vector Fv; performing semantic analysis on the natural language instruction to obtain a language feature vector F1; performing cross-modal feature alignment on the Fv and the Fl to obtain an aligned feature vector Fvl; performing action decoding and parameterized mapping processing on the Fvl to generate an action parameter vector Fd; and the Fd is input into a control execution module, kinematics solution and control instruction generation are carried out, and therefore automatic execution equipment is driven to complete bolt tightening operation. According to the method, the accuracy, adaptability and stability of bolt tightening work under complex working conditions can be improved, and the labor cost of bolt tightening work is effectively reduced.

sources.title: Robot control method based on lightweight multi-modal large model [CN122584370A]
sources.abstract: The invention provides a robot control method based on a lightweight multi-modal large model, and relates to the technical field of body intelligence, robot control and multi-modal large models. In order to solve the problems that an existing vision-language-action model is low in calculation efficiency, high in training resource requirement and large in data dependence degree in actual deployment, a sparse activation control sub-module is constructed, and a part of network layers or attention branches in a pre-training multi-mode backbone network are selectively started; and a time sequence motion decoding module is constructed to fuse the current multi-mode hidden layer features and the historical time sequence context features so as to generate a robot motion instruction. According to the invention, a two-stage training method of offline feature extraction and action strategy learning decoupling is also adopted, multi-modal hidden layer features are cached, and a time sequence action decoding module is trained based on the cache, so that repeated trunk forward calculation and gradient return are reduced.

sources.title: VLA model-oriented single-task fast and slow collaborative residual real-time adaptation method and system [CN122593022A]
sources.abstract: The invention provides a VLA model-oriented single-task fast and slow collaborative residual real-time adaptation method and system, and relates to the technical field of intelligent and robot control. According to the method, a high-frequency residual strategy based on enhanced multi-modal state observation and dynamic residual scaling factor regulation and control is superposed on a low-frequency action block generated by a pre-training VLA model of parameter freezing, so that a fast and slow collaborative real-time adaptation architecture is successfully constructed; therefore, the advantages of general semantic understanding and task planning of the pre-trained VLA model are reserved, and the inherent defect that an original model cannot respond to environmental dynamic disturbance and sudden contact events in real time due to an open-loop action block mechanism is effectively overcome through high-frequency closed-loop residual correction adjustment; under the synergistic effect of the technical characteristics, the adaptability, accuracy and robustness of the VLA model in the specific task execution process are remarkably improved finally on the premise that the original generalization ability of the model is not damaged.

sources.title: Data acquisition and marking and training verification method and device, equipment, medium and program product [CN122572681A]
authors: HENAN DUOJING DATA TECH CO LTD
sources.organization: HENAN DUOJING DATA TECH CO LTD
sources.abstract: The invention is suitable for the technical field of data annotation, and provides a data acquisition and identification and training verification method and device, equipment, a medium and a program product, and the method comprises the steps: carrying out the fragmentation uploading and identification binding of original collection data based on an instance task configuration parameter, and obtaining a collection record; performing semantic marking on the basis of the collection record, generating a marking record, performing quality auditing circulation on the marking record, and outputting a target data set after the auditing is finished; the target data set is mounted to a VLA model, training, simulation engine strategy reasoning verification and real robot reasoning verification are sequentially executed, and a training verification result is obtained.According to the method, the blank of the ability of multi-modal synchronous labeling and action process fine-grained semantic labeling of a universal labeling tool in an intelligent scene is filled; and an end-to-end closed loop from data acquisition to model verification to data set iterative optimization is realized.

sources.title: Total element minimum closed-loop system for cross-ontology deployment of VLA model [CN122539364A]
sources.abstract: The invention discloses a total element minimum closed-loop system for cross-ontology deployment of a VLA model, and the system comprises a data collection module which employs an incremental joint space teaching method to represent human teaching behaviors, and carries out the incremental control of a robot through the mapping of the relative movement in a joint space; the data acquisition module constructs a unified data structure space: developing an automatic data processing method, converting heterogeneous robot space state data into a standardized data set required by a VLA model, and taking the standardized data set as input of the model training module; the parallel reasoning module builds a parallel reasoning framework and an action output adjusting mechanism, the parallel reasoning framework decouples three operation stages of image acquisition, visual coding and model reasoning, a self-adaptive unified clock is designed to dynamically regulate and control data of each stage in real time, a predicted action sequence is output, the action output adjusting mechanism selects an optimal action frame, and the optimal action frame is subjected to motion prediction. And sending to the robot for execution. According to the method, the cross-ontology migration difficulty of the VLA model can be greatly reduced.

sources.title: Multi-modal robot long-range operation method based on large language model and symbol planning verification [CN122539345A]
sources.abstract: The invention discloses a multi-modal robot long-range operation method based on a large language model and symbol planning verification, and relates to the technical field of robot intelligent control, task planning and body intelligence. The method is oriented to a robot long-range operation task and comprises the following steps: firstly, taking a pre-trained vision-language-action model as a reference strategy, introducing a residual reinforcement learning expert on the basis of action output of the reference strategy, carrying out hot start through departure strategy data generated by reference strategy roolout, and carrying out reinforcement learning training in combination with in-process strategy data generated by online interaction; the method comprises the following steps of: firstly, acquiring an atomic skill data set, further acquiring error recovery, failure correction, boundary state processing and strategy induction data to form an enhanced skill data set, then performing symbolic modeling on the atomic skill, and establishing a mapping relation between a symbolic action and an atomic skill strategy and a mapping relation between a symbolic parameter and a continuous control parameter; and generating or updating the planning field description file. In the task execution stage, multi-modal input of voice/text instructions, visual perception information, environment states, robot states and the like is obtained, and residual reinforcement learning experts, short board data distillation, training after reinforcement, skill symbolization planning and a double closed-loop error correction mechanism are integrally designed; and the success rate, robustness, expandability and interpretability of long-range operation tasks of the robot are improved.

sources.title: Ionized layer disturbance detection and GNSS positioning response method and system [CN122546249A]
sources.abstract: The invention discloses an ionosphere disturbance detection and GNSS positioning response method and system, and belongs to the technical field of satellite navigation positioning. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring GNSS observation data to construct a TEC graph and an ROTI graph, and forming an N-frame dual-channel input sequence by the TEC graph and the ROTI graph at the current moment and N-1 moments before the current moment; extracting spatial texture features and time sequence evolution features through a visual encoder, and generating visual features; performing cross-modal semantic reasoning on the visual features through a language reasoning module to generate fusion features; and outputting an ionosphere disturbance early warning level and a GNSS positioning parameter adjustment suggestion through the action head, and autonomously triggering parameter switching of a GNSS positioning algorithm. According to the method, synchronous sensing of ionized layer disturbance space texture and time sequence evolution is realized through the VLA model, GNSS positioning parameters are adaptively adjusted, and continuous and reliable operation of high-precision positioning service under the ionized layer disturbance condition is guaranteed.

sources.title: Thinking chain hijacking security analysis method and system for VLA model [CN122508586A]
sources.abstract: The invention discloses a thinking chain hijacking safety analysis method and system for a VLA model, and belongs to the field of artificial intelligence safety and intelligent. The method comprises the following steps: firstly, acquiring a to-be-tested VLA model and acquiring a normal track to construct an offline test data set; initializing an adversarial patch and superposing the adversarial patch to an original visual observation target position to generate adversarial observation; further constructing a joint optimization loss function containing thinking chain confrontation loss and action confrontation loss, and generating a preset target thinking chain and a target action when the constraint model inputs a non-tampering instruction; performing iterative optimization by using an optimization algorithm to obtain an optimal adversarial patch; and finally, carrying out thinking chain hijacking vulnerability testing on the to-be-tested model by adopting the optimal patch. The method is high in concealment and wide in application range, hidden directional hijacking of robot behaviors is achieved on the premise that user instructions are not tampered, potential safety hazards of an inference layer of the VLA model can be effectively detected, and support is provided for safe deployment of an intelligent system with a body.

sources.title: Non-rigid fabric operation-oriented low-cost remote control double-mechanical-arm VLA model teaching data set construction and training method [CN122500720A]
sources.organization: WOAN TECH SHENZHEN CO LTD, HARBIN INST OF TECHNOLOGY
sources.abstract: The invention provides a non-rigid fabric operation-oriented low-cost remote control double-mechanical-arm VLA model teaching data set construction and training method, and belongs to the technical field of a VLA intelligent technology, a collaborative robot technology and machine learning. The method comprises the following steps: step 1, calibrating the adaptability of a body intelligent agent target scene and master-slave isomorphic body hardware; step 2, constructing a two-stage equal-duration progressive teaching data set based on the self-cognition logic; 3, preprocessing and standardizing the multi-mode teleoperation teaching data of the intelligent agent with the body; and step 4, performing two-stage customized training on the body VLA model based on the progressive data set. According to the method, the domain generalization ability and the environment self-adaption ability of the household low-cost double-mechanical-arm body intelligent agent in an unstructured flexible operation scene are greatly improved; the problem of adaptation between a universal body VLA model and low-cost body hardware is solved; and the learning convergence efficiency and the action migration capability of the intelligent agent with the body are improved.

sources.title: Vision-language-action moving operation method and system based on multi-view geometric vision coding [CN122493520A]
sources.abstract: The invention discloses a vision-language-action moving operation method and system based on multi-view geometric vision coding, and belongs to the field of robot perception control and intelligent ownership. A multi-view geometric vision coder is introduced on the basis of a semantic vision coder of a base vision-language-action model; in combination with residual projection and a low-rank adaptation mode, moving operation training data including multi-view image observation, a language instruction and an expert action sequence are utilized, parameters of a residual projection module, a vision-language model and an attention layer in an action expert are subjected to efficient parameter fine adjustment, fused features can stably participate in action generation, and the action generation efficiency is improved. Therefore, the understanding ability of the model for the target position, the operation area and the three-dimensional space relation is improved, the training cost is reduced, the success rate of continuous tasks of mobile operation such as navigation, approaching, grabbing and putting is improved, and the method is suitable for mobile operation tasks needing spatial reasoning and real robot deployment scenes.

findings.rationale: The retrieved publications show VLA models being applied to recursive humanoid robot manufacturing, non-contact tomato picking, UAV obstacle avoidance, and urban traffic inspection, indicating broad cross-industry interest in foundation models for physical control.

findings.claim: Applicants are actively patenting methods to address core VLA limitations, specifically short-term memory constraints, high computational latency, and poor real-time environmental adaptation.

companies: QINGDAO HAIER INTELLIGENT TECHNOLOGY RES & DEV CO LTD

draft.summary: Research on vision-language-action (VLA) models is accelerating very fast: matching works rose from 50 in 2024 to 540 in 2025, and 2,562 had appeared by 10 November 2026 versus 303 at the same point in 2025 [S10]. Patent filings show a similar surge, from 32 in 2025 to 145 so far in 2026, spreading into humanoid manufacturing, agriculture and drones [P1]. Technical progress is reported on open models, efficiency and long-horizon manipulation [S2][S5], but Risk findings document memorization, weak compositional generalization, safety gaps and immature failure detection [R1][R2][R3][R7]. Much of the positive evidence is self-reported by developers, mostly from simulation benchmarks [R8][C2][C3][C5]. Commercial evidence is thin: the Market agent did not run, and the only deployment and customer statements are unverified social posts [X1][X5]. The main uncertainty is whether benchmark and lab gains will become reliable real-world performance, and that is not yet shown.
draft.plain_summary: A vision-language-action model is a type of AI that looks at the world, understands instructions in words, and tells a robot what to do. Research and patent filings are growing extremely fast, but the evidence that these robots work reliably outside the lab is still thin and mostly comes from the developers themselves. Independent tests show the models often memorize rather than truly adapt, and that could stop real-world use.

Compute and latency constraints [R6] and immature failure detection [R7] block safety-critical use. The headline results come from simulation and developer papers [R8][C5], so real-world performance falls short and the hype fades.
